_what: R-C9-205 (3): DEV-18 snow artifacts fix -- pilot_03 (knight_uv [-9.6137,14.9608]), 1920x1080 stills (pt_pilot_stills.gd)
cause: the painted snow's projection re-sampled the ground-height grid per fragment (bilinear), not the height the vertex was lifted to (piecewise linear): on steep bank cells the paint was read off the wrong height -> tents / wavy streaks
fix: snow_field_terrain.gd: ground height taken once at the vertex, carried as varying v_gh to the projection

before_vs_snowfix_only._outside: heather tips and snowflakes (wind/snowfall frame noise); open snow, ice, stones unchanged

_full: the reed split re-places heather off the straw (one plant per tuft) + 31 reed cards
isolation: after renders in an APFS clone with HEAD bv2f_level.gd and the pilot's pinned level (LV's art/ level and bv2f_level.gd are being rebuilt in place)
